nina: quick sync - planning a targeted deploy at 21:00 UTC to flip header_sidecar and roll a small runtime patch. need api/runtime/router/console watch. no schema/db changes.

omar: what's pinned? variants?

nina: runtime: rtf-3.1.0-hotfix (pin), api: api-3.1.0->canary api-3.1.2-canary, router: header_sidecar toggle behind rollout. console: monitoring only.

elie: canary plan? i suggest 4% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% with short pauses. keep autoscaler frozen first two steps.

carla: noted. i'll wire alerts for p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, and runtime CPU p99. also synthetic hitting header path.

omar: rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback if 5xx > 0.7% for 3m OR p99 latency > baseline *1.6 for 2m OR runtime CPU p99 > 92% for 1m. Otherwise pause and investigate.

nina: add manual rollback if console shows customer errors in 3+ regions. rollback owner = omar, postmortem = nina.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled rollout at 1764663600 (2026-10-04 21:00 UTC). Steps: pin runtime, deploy api-canary 4%, flip router header for 4%, monitor 8m, ramp per cadence. Command: /deploy --pin rtf-3.1.0-hotfix --canary api-3.1.2-canary --router-toggle header_sidecar --cadence 8m,12m,10m

elie: ops action: opsbot freeze autoscaler and set kv eviction threshold to 0.86 for rollout scope.

opsbot: opsbot: autoscaler frozen for pool runtime-dedicated until 1764667200. kv-evict-threshold set to 0.86 for rollout-1764661234.

carla: synthetic baseline taken: p95=180ms, p99=410ms, error-rate=0.05%. dashboards ready and pager rules set.

omar: variant ids: rtf-3.1.0-hotfix@sha256:aa99bb, api-3.1.2-canary@sha256:cc33dd, router-cfg:sidecar-v2.

nina: final checklist: variants validated, autoscaler freeze, synth baseline, dashboards+alerts, rollback owner assigned. tagging deploybot to run.

deploybot: deploybot: acknowledged. will post progress updates in-thread during rollout.
